parallel_w12_lanes.notes: Operations records only: integrate OPS-13A artifacts and refresh director truth. Does not deploy, import, run provider canaries, or run OPS-13B.

convergence_order: Use W12-99 head 0d8d7168f066668f035176d777bdaaa4dcc5accd as the candidate input, not main, PR #61, PR #72, or an individual W12 lane branch.
Treat W12-00 through W12-08 as integrated by W12-99.
Keep W12-09 excluded until an explicit operator decision adds it to scope.
Use OPS-13A only as a sanitized preflight input; it is not import acceptance or provider acceptance proof.
Do not run OPS-13B unless a later prompt explicitly scopes it.
Deploy one exact candidate SHA to isolated staging only in the W12-100 launch-proof lane.
Run full owner/admin/parent/student journeys only after isolated staging exists.
Produce counts-only real-audience import preview and conflict report before any write-stage approval.
Do not treat source metadata row counts as deduplicated people counts.
Apply real audience data only after explicit approval of exact counts/conflicts/rollback.
Run one-recipient protected provider canaries only with explicit authorization and protected credentials.
Promote the exact verified build only after rollback/readiness proof.
Keep BNA on its separate convergence train unless a later One Time prompt explicitly scopes a bridge contract.
